---
name: Usage report or feedback
about: Describe a real trial, integration issue, or measured outcome
title: "[Usage] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

### Task and version
What did you evaluate? Include CalibRoute version and Python version.
Organization/name is optional; do not disclose private client details.

### Setup
What was one prediction unit, correctness rule, and confidence signal?
How were development and holdout data separated? Was this synthetic, research,
an offline pilot, or live use?

### Results and comparison
If measured: sample size, baseline, accepted-set errors/accepted count,
automatic coverage, review count, abstention count, and review workload.
Negative findings and unsuccessful trials are useful too.

### What helped or failed?
Include reproducible steps or a minimal synthetic example where possible.
Do not post sensitive documents, credentials, personal data, or private logs.

### Links (optional)
Public experiment, integration, paper, or reproducible report. Filing an issue
does not constitute an endorsement or consent to be quoted as a testimonial.
